verdict.rationale: Extend's docs describe one file-upload endpoint that registers any supported file for parsing, extraction and workflows. The supported-types page lists PDF, images (PNG/JPG/TIFF), Excel (XLS/XLSX) and Word (DOC/DOCX), and Word and PowerPoint uploads are auto-converted to PDF, so most of the mix works without per-format plumbing. HTML and email are never shown as supported, which leaves two of the story's seven formats unevidenced. missing for 10: evidence of HTML support, evidence of email (EML/MSG) support, explicit PPTX listing on the supported-types page, independent hands-on corroboration of mixed-format API ingestion
